name: Binaural Jazz
description: A jazz club built for headphones: the bass, kick and lead horn stay in the centre while the rest of the band uses the space between your ears. A kit set up around you, a ballad widened by tiny delays, a modal vamp whose phase rotates, horn chords split by partials, vibes that hop from ear to ear, a smoky room with glasses clinking behind you, guide tones hidden in noise, a bebop line whose brightness wanders, a bossa that drifts apart in cents and a last-call ballad over a slow delta drone. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Brushes in the Round
sketches.description: A swinging ii-V-I in F with the kit set up around you: the ride on your right, the hats on your left, brushes circling your head, piano a little to the left and the saxophone straight ahead.
sketches.source:
setcpm(132/4)

// The walking bass and a feathered kick stay dead centre: Gm7, C7, Fmaj7, D7
bass: note("<[g1 bb1 d2 f2] [c2 e2 g2 bb2] [f1 a1 c2 e2] [d2 f#2 a2 c3]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.5)
kick: s("bd*4").lpf(200).gain(.3)

// The kit is set up around you: the ride on your right, the hats on your left
ride: s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").azimuth(50).distance(2).gain(.24)
hats: s("~ hh ~ hh").azimuth(-50).distance(2).gain(.26)

// Brushes sweep a circle around your head every two bars
brushes: s("pink*8").hpf(3000).lpf(8000).decay(.08).sustain(0).swing(4)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2)).distance(1.5).posglide(.3).gain(.05)

// Piano comping a little to the left, the saxophone straight ahead
piano: note("<[f3,a3,bb3,d4] [e3,g3,bb3,d4] [e3,a3,c4,d4] [f#3,a3,c4,eb4]>")
  .struct("~ [~@2 x] ~ x").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .decay(.4).sustain(.1).release(.3).azimuth(-25).distance(2.5).room(.3).gain(.22)
sax: note("<[d5@2 c5 bb4 a4@2 g4@2] [bb4@3 a4 g4 e4@3] [a4@4 c5@2 e5@2] [d5@2 c5 a4 f#4@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o").lpf(2400).vib(5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.2).distance(3).room(.4).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Wide Ballad
sketches.description: A ballad in E-flat where delays between the ears do the mixing: the piano grows wider each bar as its delay rises from 1 to 25 milliseconds, the brushes sway on delays under a millisecond, and the tenor sax has no delay at all.

sketches.name: Modal Rotation
sketches.description: A modal vamp in D dorian that lifts to E-flat dorian after four bars. The quartal pad steps from centred to diffuse through interaural phase, while a vibraphone drone rolls slowly around inside your head, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)

// Four bars of D dorian, then four a half step up
const lift = "<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>"

// A centred kit: ride, hats on two and four, a lazy kick
drums: stack(
  s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(.24),
  s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(.22),
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [~ bd?0.4] ~").lpf(250).seed("modal").gain(.3)
)
bass: n("0 4 6 [3 2]").scale("D:dorian").sub(12).add(lift)
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.48)

// Quartal chords: 0 degrees centred, 90 looser, 180 diffuse and nearly gone in mono
pad: note("[e3,a3,d4,g4]").add(lift).s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .iphase("<0 90 180 90>").lpf(1400).attack(.6).sustain(.8).release(1).room(.5).gain(.14)
comp: note("[e3,a3,d4,g4]").struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ ~").add(lift)
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2).decay(.5).sustain(.2).release(.3).lpf(2400).gain(.2)

// A vibraphone drone whose phase between the ears turns a quarter to one time a second
vibes: note("[d4,a4]").add(lift).s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).irate("<.25 .5 1 .5>")
  .attack(.5).sustain(.7).release(1).gain(.1)

// The trumpet plays the theme, straight ahead
trumpet: n("<[4@3 3 2@2 0@2] [1@4 ~@4] [4@2 5 6 7@4] [6@2 4@2 3@4]>").scale("D:dorian").transpose(12).add(lift)
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(2600).mono(1).glide(.04).vib(5).vibdepth(.08)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.6).release(.2).room(.4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Split Quartet
sketches.description: Spectral fusion on the bandstand: the horn section's chords send alternate partials to each ear, and the kit splits its lows from its cymbals at 900 Hz. Neither ear hears the whole band; together, and in mono, it is complete.
sketches.source:
setcpm(108/4)

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the partials of each chord between the ears: F7, Bb7, F7, C7
horns: note("<[f3,a3,c4,eb4] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [f3,a3,c4,eb4] [c3,e3,g3,bb3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sawtooth").earsplit("harmonics").lpf(2000)
  .decay(.6).sustain(.2).release(.4).room(.4).gain(.18)

// earsplit("bands") puts the kick and snare body in one ear and the ride in the other
drums: s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ sd ~ sd, rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]")
  .earsplit("bands").splitfreq(900).gain(.5)

// A plain, centred walking bass
bass: note("<[f2 a2 c3 eb3] [bb1 d2 f2 ab2] [f2 eb2 d2 c2] [c2 e2 g2 bb2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.48)

// A centred guitar answers between the chords
guitar: n("<[~ ~ 4 5 6 4 ~ ~] [~ ~ 3 4 3 1 0 ~] [~ ~ 6 7 9 7 6 4] [5@4 ~@4]>").scale("F:mixolydian").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.3).sustain(.2).release(.2).swing(4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Ear-to-Ear Vibes
sketches.description: A bebop vibraphone leans right with a level difference between the ears, and a patterned ear swap flips some notes to the left, so the line hops between your ears. A guitar answers on the other side, swapping once a bar.
sketches.source:
setcpm(144/4)

// ild makes the right ear louder; earswap flips the ears on the steps marked 1
// Through Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7, G7
vibes: n("0 2 4 6 7 6 4 2").add("<0 5 1 4>").scale("C:major").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).ild(9).earswap("0 1 0 1 1 0 1 0")
  .decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).swing(4).gain(.2)

// A guitar counter-line that swaps ears once per bar
guitar: n("<[~ 4 ~ 2] [~ 0 ~ 2] [~ 3 ~ 1] [~ 6 ~ 4]>").scale("C:major")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").ild(6).earswap("<0 1>")
  .decay(.4).sustain(.2).release(.3).gain(.18)

// A centred walking bass and kit
bass: note("<[c2 e2 g2 b2] [a1 c2 e2 g2] [d2 f2 a2 c3] [g1 b1 d2 f2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.48)
drums: stack(
  s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(.24),
  s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(.22),
  s("bd*4").lpf(200).gain(.28)
)

sketches.name: Smoky Club
sketches.description: Headphones on: a table near the stage. The band plays in front of you, the room tone is wide and diffuse, glasses clink at the bar behind you and footsteps pass in the lobby beyond the wall.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// The room: chatter, unrelated noise in each ear for a wide room tone, and glasses at the bar behind you
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(.1)
roomtone: s("pink").slow(8).icorr(.15).lpf(1200).gain(.03)
glasses: s("click*8?0.15").hpf(3000).azimuth(160).distance(4).seed("bar").gain(.12)

// Footsteps in the lobby, beyond the wall
lobby: s("step ~ step ~").azimuth(-120).distance(5).occlude(.6).gain(.1)

// The band on stage: drums at the back, bass on the left, piano on the right, horn in front
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd?0.3, ~ sd?0.2 ~ sd, rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").distance(4).seed("club").room(.3).gain(.4)
bass: note("<[bb1 d2 f2 a2] [g1 b1 d2 f2] [c2 eb2 g2 bb2] [f1 a1 c2 eb2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).azimuth(-30).distance(3).gain(.46)
piano: note("<[a3,d4,f4] [b3,d4,f4] [bb3,eb4,g4] [a3,eb4,g4]>").struct("~ [~@2 x] ~ [~@2 x]")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(.1).release(.3).azimuth(35).distance(3).gain(.22)

// A muted trumpet, close in front
trumpet: note("<[d5@3 c5 bb4@2 f4@2] [g4@4 b4@2 d5@2] [eb5@3 d5 c5@2 bb4 g4] [a4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").vowel("u").lpf(2000).vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.2).distance(2).room(.3).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Ghost Changes
sketches.description: The off-beat brushes are white noise, but between the ears they carry the chord tones of a ii-V-I (Huggins pitch). Each ear alone hears only hiss. A quiet vibraphone plays the first bar every four bars so you know what to listen for. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: Bebop Brightness
sketches.description: Nothing is panned, yet a fast bebop line's brightness bounces between your ears: each ear has its own low-pass, sweeping in opposite directions. The comping pad is thinner on the right, where a high-pass cuts its body.
sketches.source:
setcpm(168/4)

// A fast, centred kit
drums: stack(
  s("rd [rd@2 rd] rd [rd@2 rd]").gain(.24),
  s("~ hh ~ hh").gain(.22),
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ ~ ~ ~").seed("bop").gain(.3)
)

// A low-pass on each ear alone, sweeping in opposite directions every four bars
// The level stays put; only the brightness wanders: Gm7, C7, Fmaj7, D7
line: n("0 2 4 6 7 5 4 3").add("<1 4 0 5>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .s("sawtooth").lpq(4)
  .lcutoff(saw.range(400, 4000).slow(4)).rcutoff(isaw.range(400, 4000).slow(4))
  .decay(.15).sustain(.3).release(.05).swing(4).gain(.18)

// A high-pass on the right ear only: the comping sounds fuller on the left
comp: note("<[f3,a3,bb3,d4] [e3,g3,bb3,d4] [e3,a3,c4,d4] [f#3,a3,c4,eb4]>").struct("~ [~@2 x] ~ x")
  .s("triangle").rhcutoff(1200).decay(.4).sustain(.2).release(.3).room(.3).gain(.2)

bass: note("<[g1 bb1 d2 f2] [c2 e2 g2 bb2] [f1 a1 c2 e2] [d2 f#2 a2 c3]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.46)

sketches.name: Cents Bossa
sketches.description: Bossa nova for headphones: the nylon-string chords drift apart between the ears in cents, a chord at a time. At 2 cents they beat slowly, at 6 and 12 they shimmer and at 30 they bloom into a chorus. The flute, bass and clave stay centred.
sketches.source:
setcpm(136/8)

// One cycle is two bars. The clave on the rim, a brushed shaker and a soft surdo kick
perc: stack(
  s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").gain(.4),
  s("hh*16").hpf(6000).gain(saw.range(.1, .24).fast(8)),
  s("bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd").lpf(260).gain(.5)
)

// earsh raises the right ear and lowers the left by half the value each: Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7, G7
guitar: note("<[e3,g3,b3,d4] [e3,g3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4,e4] [f3,b3,d4,e4]>")
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").earsh("<2 6 12 30>")
  .attack(.003).decay(.35).sustain(0).release(.3).lpf(2400).room(.35).gain(.28)

// Upright bass on the dotted quarter, and a breathy flute in the middle
bass: note("<[c2@3 g1]*4 [a1@3 e2]*4 [d2@3 a1]*4 [g1@3 d2]*4>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.15).gain(.55)
flute: note("<[g5@2 e5 d5 b4@3 ~] [c5@2 b4 a4 e5@3 ~] [f5@3 e5 c5@2 a4 c5] [d5@2 b4 g4 f4@3 ~]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.12).attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.4)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Last Call Delta
sketches.description: The last set, chairs on the tables: a slow ballad in F over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. A sparse piano, soft brushes and a tenor sax far across the empty room.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)

// A 2 Hz binaural drone: each ear is detuned by 1 Hz, so a slow beat forms between them
// Fmaj7, Dm7, Gm7, C7
drone: note("<f1 d1 g1 c1>").s("sine").binaural(2)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.24)

// Sparse piano, a few notes gently left out
piano: n("<[2 ~ 4 ~] [~ 6 ~ 4] [3 ~ ~ 5] [~ 4 ~ 2]>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("last-call")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(1.5).sustain(.1).release(2)
  .room(.6).size(.85).gain(.24)
chords: note("<[e3,a3,c4] [c3,f3,a3] [f3,bb3,d4] [e3,bb3,d4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(1).sustain(.5).release(3).lpf(900).room(.6).gain(.16)

// Soft brushes, centred
brushes: s("pink*4").hpf(2500).lpf(6000).decay(.15).sustain(0).swing(4).gain(.04)

// A tenor sax far across the empty room
sax: note("<[a4@3 g4 f4@4] ~ [d5@2 c5 a4 g4@4] ~>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o").lpf(1600).mono(1).glide(.08)
  .vib(4.5).vibdepth(.15).attack(.1).sustain(.7).release(1)
  .azimuth(-20).distance(7).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.16)
